A '''line battlegroup''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A line [[Battle group|battlegroup]] was comprised of three [[line regiment]]s, an [[assault regiment]], and [[battlegroup headquarters]]. It included 14,410 personnel, 511 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 53 [[Tank|heavy tanks]]. Since the rise of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], line battlegroups were considered to be understrength.<ref name="ISB" />

Line battlegroups could be augmented by the addition of another line regiment, 2 [[artillery regiment]]s, and a [[repulsorlift regiment]].<ref name="ISB2" />
